description: This file defines the EndpointRule class, which extends AbstractRule and encapsulates logic for evaluating and resolving endpoint configurations based on input parameters and a standard library. It includes methods for evaluating conditions, resolving endpoint URLs, properties, and headers, and returns a RulesetEndpoint object when conditions are met.

classes.name: EndpointRule
classes.description: A class representing a rule for resolving service endpoints, including evaluating conditions and assembling endpoint details such as URL, headers, and properties based on input parameters.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the EndpointRule with a definition array, setting the endpoint property.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates whether the rule's conditions are met, and if so, resolves and returns the endpoint; otherwise returns false.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves the endpoint's URL, properties, and headers into a RulesetEndpoint object.

methods.name: resolveProperties
methods.description: Recursively resolves the properties attribute of the endpoint, handling templates.

methods.name: resolveHeaders
methods.description: Resolves the headers attribute of the endpoint, processing each header value through the standard library.
